events.title: ‘An assault on humanity itself’: Guterres pays tribute to 9/11 victims, survivors and first responders
events.summary: Twenty-five years ago, the heinous terrorist attacks of 11 September 2001 against the United States claimed thousands of lives and represented “an assault on humanity itself”, the UN chief said on Thursday.

events.title: Human cost of violence in South Sudan ‘continues to grow’
